statement: H100 cloud rental rates dropped from roughly $7-$10 per GPU-hour at 2023 launch to about $2-$4 per GPU-hour by late 2025, with A100 rates at roughly $1.29-$3.43 per hour.
why: Rental prices are the clearest read on whether rented GPU capacity is scarce or abundant, and a roughly two-thirds decline points to supply catching up on prior-generation parts.

impact.mechanism: Falling rental rates for prior-generation accelerators indicate ample rentable capacity at that tier and compress returns for operators who bought at peak.

evidence.excerpt: from roughly $7-$10/hr at launch in 2023 to about $2-$4/hr by late 2025
A100 rates range from roughly $1.29-$3.43/hr depending on provider

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregation of provider rate cards without stated methodology; April 2026 vintage.

dispersion: Rates vary materially by provider; A100 spans $1.29-$3.43/hr and H100 $2-$4/hr.
